It is part of the multi-sport organization [[Stabæk IF]]. Founded in 1912, the club's name is an archaic spelling of the suburban area [[Stabekk]], from which it once originated. The club currently competes in the [[Norwegian first division]], the second tier of [[Football in Norway]]. Their home stadium is the [[Nadderud Stadion]] after a three-year-long stay at the [[Telenor Arena]]. Their current chairman is Espen Moe.
